column2: Mount Penglai, the legendary home of the Taoist Immortals, lies somewhere to the east. Few who have set out for there have been successful, and many have vanished or died in the attempt, but when the prize is eternal life perhaps the risk is worth it...
Immortality will be mine!

[From.GetBestName] has ordered that ships be prepared for an expedition meant to reach Mount Penglai, the legendary home of the Taoist Immortals. In the past, such expeditions have generally ended in failure or death, but perhaps [From.GetBestName] will be luckier than most...
I wish [From.GetHerHim] luck!
I hope it goes as well as it did for Qin Shi Huangdi!
Perhaps I should try to sabotage this endeavour...
Mount Penglai truly is mere fiction, that much has become clear to me. I should not waste any more time or resources trying to get there.
I no longer care for that nonsense!
It seems [From.GetBestName] no longer cares to try to reach Mount Penglai, seeing as [From.GetSheHe] has announced that the expedition there no longer will depart.
I see...
There are no longer any ports in my realm from which a fleet could set sail for Mount Penglai. As such, the expedition needs to be cancelled.
I guess that's that...
Due to a lack of suitable ports [From.GetBestName] has ordered that the planned expedition to Mount Penglai should be postponed indefinitely.
I see...

Given that I am now a mere [Root.GetTitle] I do not think I can afford to send an expedition to Mount Penglai, particularly as I do not think I command enough respect to convince the Immortals to give me a Peach of Immortality.
I guess I have to give up on this...
It seems [From.GetBestName] has given up on [From.GetHerHis] quest to reach Mount Penglai, seeing as [From.GetSheHe] now is a mere [From.GetTitle].
I see...
The ongoing conflict requires all of my attention and all of my resources. I cannot afford to launch an expedition to Mount Penglai as things currently stand.
I have more important matters to see to!
[From.GetBestName] has given up on [From.GetHerHis] quest to reach Mount Penglai, at least for the time being. The ongoing conflict seems to be [From.GetHerHis] main priority.
I see...
I can no longer launch an expedition to Mount Penglai. It will have to be postponed.
I guess so...
It seems circumstances have forced [From.GetBestName] to postpone [From.GetHerHis] expedition to Mount Penglai indefinitely.
I see...
As the preparations for my expedition to Mount Penglai continue I have found myself considering what the focus should be. There is limited time and resources available, after all.
Military preparations are paramount!
We'll need all the charts we can get!
Additional ships would be most worthwhile!
Knowledge about the Immortals and Penglai is necessary!

Some of the funds I have set aside for my expedition to Mount Penglai are for the people I will be bringing along. I should prioritize a single category, even if I will of course be bringing a lot of different people.
I need to bring skilled soldiers with me!
Young men and maidens should be brought along!
The best sailors must crew the ships!
Scholars and mystics will be needed!
As the preparations for the expedition to Mount Penglai continue I need to decide whether I actually should depart on it personally or if I should send someone else. Either might have its advantages.
I am going myself, of course!
I will ask [penglai_vassal.GetBestName] to go in my stead!
I have just received a request from [From.GetBestName], asking me to set out for Mount Penglai in [From.GetHerHis] stead. Such a journey could both present great dangers and great opportunities...
Of course I'll go!
I suppose I could ensure that Peach of Immortality falls into my hands...
If I get paid, I'll go!
In exchange for a future Favor, sure!
Fine, if we consider that Favor repaid...
I expect a suitable amount of Grace for this!
Absolutely not!
I'd rather sabotage this from here...
[From.GetBestName] was quite eager to agree to my request. [From.GetSheHeCap] did not even see fit to ask for anything in return.
That's what I wanted to hear!

[From.GetBestName] was not entirely opposed to the suggestion that [From.GetSheHe] perhaps could try to find Mount Penglai for me, but [From.GetSheHe] also pointed out that [From.GetSheHe] really should be paid for such a service.
Very well!
I'd rather go myself...
[From.GetBestName] agreed to my suggestion that I should be paid upfront in exchange for me setting off to search for Mount Penglai and a Peach of Immortality for [From.GetHerHim].
Excellent!
[From.GetBestName] was not willing to agree to my suggestion that I should be paid a substantial amount of money in exchange for me taking charge of the expedition to Mount Penglai.
I see...

[From.GetBestName] was not entirely opposed to the suggestion that [From.GetSheHe] perhaps could try to find Mount Penglai for me, but suggested that [From.GetSheHe] in that case would be doing me a favor and should be owed one in exchange.
Very well!
I'd rather go myself...
[From.GetBestName] agreed to my suggestion that I should be owed a Favor in exchange for me setting off to search for Mount Penglai and a Peach of Immortality for [From.GetHerHim].
Excellent!
[From.GetBestName] was not willing to agree to my suggestion that I should be owed a Favor in exchange for me taking charge of the expedition to Mount Penglai.
I see...

[From.GetBestName] was not entirely opposed to the suggestion that [From.GetSheHe] perhaps could try to find Mount Penglai for me, but suggested that it really would be sensible to consider it a repayment of the Favor [From.GetSheHe] currently owes me.
Very well!
I'd rather go myself...

[From.GetBestName] agreed to my suggestion that we should consider me setting off to search for Mount Penglai and a Peach of Immortality for [From.GetHerHim] a suitable repayment of the Favor I owed [From.GetHerHim].
Excellent!
[From.GetBestName] was not willing to agree to my suggestion that the Favor I owe [From.GetHerHim] should be considered repaid in exchange for me taking charge of the expedition to Mount Penglai.
I see...

[From.GetBestName] was not entirely opposed to the suggestion that [From.GetSheHe] perhaps could try to find Mount Penglai for me, but suggested that such a service to the Dragon Throne probably should involve the [Root.GetSonDaughterCap] of Heaven bestowing a substantial amount of Grace in return.
Very well!
I'd rather go myself...

[From.GetBestName] agreed to my suggestion that the Dragon Throne should bestow a suitable amount of Grace in exchange for me setting off to search for Mount Penglai and a Peach of Immortality for the [From.GetSonDaughterCap] of Heaven.
Excellent!
[From.GetBestName] was not willing to agree to my suggestion that the Dragon Throne should bestow some Grace on me in exchange for me taking charge of the expedition to Mount Penglai.
I see...
[From.GetBestName] has informed me that [From.GetSheHe] cannot in good conscience abandon affairs at home to sail off in search of a legend, not even if said legend is Mount Penglai.
Fine! I'll go myself!

[This.Liege.GetBestName]'s upcoming expedition to Mount Penglai should ideally end in failure, and I think I am in a good position to make sure that it does. The only question now is how I go about doing it.
I will attempt to sabotage the preparations!
I will hire an assassin and have them sneak aboard!
I will sow dissent at home instead!
Actually, I don't think I will do anything...
[penglai_vassal.GetBestName] has died and can therefore no longer assume command of the expedition to Mount Penglai.
I guess I'll have to go myself, then...
It is time for my expedition to Mount Penglai. Time and tide waits for no [Root.GetManWoman], and I do not yet have an eternity to wait for it.
All aboard!

[From.GetBestName]'s expedition has set sail under [From.GetHerHis] personal command, attempting to reach Mount Penglai and the Immortals that dwell there. In the past, such endeavours have generally ended in failure, but perhaps this time things will go differently...
I wonder what they'll find...
With [penglai_vassal.GetBestName] in no position to assume command and the ships ready to depart, it has become clear to me that I need to take charge of the expedition.
I'll have to do this myself...
[From.GetBestName] has assumed personal command of [From.GetHerHis] expedition to Mount Penglai, seeing as I am no longer in a position to be in command of it in [From.GetHerHis] stead.
Unfortunately, I couldn't go in [From.GetHerHis] stead...
It doesn't concern me any longer...

[From.GetBestName]'s expedition has set sail under [From.GetHerHis] personal command, attempting to reach Mount Penglai and the Immortals that dwell there. In the past, such endeavours have generally ended in failure, but perhaps this time things will go differently...
I wonder what they'll find...
The ships are ready, and [penglai_vassal.GetBestName] has formally been put in command. All I can do now is wait for [penglai_vassal.GetHerHis] return.
Bring me a Peach of Immortality!

The ships are ready to depart on the search for Mount Penglai, and I have been provided with a great quantity of signed and sealed documents outlining my broad authority when it comes to commanding the expedition in [From.GetBestName]'s name.
I will find a Peach of Immortality!

[From.GetBestName]'s expedition has set sail under the command of [penglai_vassal.GetBestName], attempting to reach Mount Penglai and the Immortals that dwell there. In the past, such endeavours have generally ended in failure, but perhaps this time things will go differently...
I wonder what they'll find...

Despite my efforts to ensure that everything would go as smoothly as possible on the way to Mount Penglai it seems insufficient supplies were brought aboard the ships. Our meals have been a bit sparse as a result, and I have lost a bit of weight.

It seems [penglai_sender.GetBestName] either did not see fit to prepare sufficient supplies for the expedition or that they never were brought aboard the ships. Our meals have been a bit sparse as a result, and I have lost a bit of weight.
Hopefully we'll catch more fish down the line...

One of the young [sex_partner.GetMenWomen] brought along on the expedition, [sex_partner.GetBestName], is rather fetching. Perhaps the two of us could make very good use of this time. I'm sure [sex_partner.GetHerHis] clothes would look great next to mine on the floor of my cabin.

One of the young [sex_partner.GetMenWomen] brought along on the expedition, [sex_partner.GetBestName], is rather fetching. Perhaps the two of us could make very good use of this time. I'm sure [sex_partner.GetHerHis] clothes would look great next to mineon the floor of my cabin.
I'll proposition [sex_partner.GetHerHim]!
I don't think so...

It seems [From.GetBestName] has taken a liking to me, seeing as [From.GetSheHe] just suggested that maybe the two of us should retire to [From.GetHerHis] cabin to get to know one another much more intimately.
A wonderful idea!
I don't think so!

[From.GetBestName] was quite receptive to my suggestion, and the two of us spent an enjoyable night together in my cabin. Perhaps we might do it again before we reach Mount Penglai, and if we do not get there, this expedition will still not have been entirely wasted.

[From.GetBestName] was quite receptive to my suggestion, and the two of us spent an enjoyable night together in my cabin. Perhaps we might do it again before we reach Mount Penglai, and if we do not get there, I suppose agreeing to go on this expedition still will have been a good idea.
We should do this again!
Actually, I think this isn't going to happen again...
[From.GetBestName] informed me in no uncertain terms that [From.GetSheHe] has no interest in spending the night with me, and politely but firmly told me not to bring up the matter again.
[From.GetBestName] informed me in no uncertain terms that [From.GetSheHe] has no interest in spending the night with me, and politely but firmly told me not to bring up the matter again.
I see...

The journey to Mount Penglai has taken quite some time, and we are not there yet. Perhaps the time could be spent on something productive, so that I may return a wiser ruler even if I do not return with eternal life.

The journey to Mount Penglai has taken quite some time, and we are not there yet. Perhaps the time could be spent on something productive, so that the trip is not wasted even if I fail to return with a Peach of Immortality.
I will spend the time studying!
I would much rather relax a bit...
I spend a few days reading up on a number of important historical treaties and the negotiations that led up to them, and manage to obtain a few useful insights.
I spend a few days reading up on a number of important historical treaties and the negotiations that led up to them, and manage to obtain a few useful insights.
I learned something from this!
I spend a few days reading up on a number of important historical battles and the manoeuvres that led up to them, and manage to obtain a few useful insights.
I spend a few days reading up on a number of important historical battles and the manoeuvres that led up to them, and manage to obtain a few useful insights.
I learned something from this!
I spend a few days reading through some recent census records and the taxes paid for the same years, and manage to obtain a few useful insights.
I spend a few days reading through some recent census records and the taxes paid for the same years, and manage to obtain a few useful insights.
I learned something from this!
I spend a few days reading through several reports from my agents and comparing the information in them with other reports further back, and manage to obtain a few useful insights.
I spend a few days reading through several reports from my agents and comparing the information in them with other reports further back, and manage to obtain a few useful insights.
I learned something from this!
I spend a few days reading through several religious and mythological texts, and manage to obtain a few useful insights.
I spend a few days reading through several religious and mythological texts, and manage to obtain a few useful insights.
I learned something from this!
Despite reading through a number of books that were unfamiliar to me on a number of different subjects I do not manage to learn anything of note.
Despite reading through a number of books that were unfamiliar to me on a number of different subjects I do not manage to learn anything of note.
Well, that was a waste of time...
I have been studying various texts well into the night, and all I have accomplished so far is getting less sleep.
I have been studying various texts well into the night, and all I have accomplished so far is getting less sleep.
Maybe I should have rested instead...
While some might frown on resting rather than taking an opportunity to learn, I must say feel like a new person after taking the opportunity to relax for a few days.
While some might frown on resting rather than taking an opportunity to learn, I must say feel like a new person after taking the opportunity to relax for a few days.
I really needed that!

One night as the expedition continues towards Mount Penglai and the Peach of Immortality that rightfully should be mine I am finding it hard to sleep and decide to get some fresh air. As I am about to head back to my cabin I notice someone moving in the shadows.

One night as the expedition continues towards Mount Penglai and the Peach of Immortality that I am supposed to bring back to [penglai_sender.GetBestName] I am finding it hard to sleep and decide to get some fresh air. As I am about to head back to my cabin I notice someone moving in the shadows.
Who goes there?

A [Root.GetManWomanOpp] lunges at me from the shadows, but I manage to avoid the blow easily enough. The assailant turns to flee, but some sailors that heard me call out catch the [Root.GetManWomanOpp] easily enough, and during the interrogation it is revealed that [penglai_rival.GetBestName] was behind the attack, clearly not wishing for me to gain eternal life.

A [Root.GetManWomanOpp] lunges at me from the shadows, but I manage to avoid the blow easily enough. The assailant turns to flee, but some sailors that heard me call out catch the [Root.GetManWomanOpp] easily enough, and during the interrogation it is revealed that [penglai_rival.GetBestName] was behind the attack, clearly not wishing for the expedition to be successful.
I will never forgive this!

A [Root.GetManWomanOpp] lunges at me from the shadows, and I barely make it out of the way in time. Instead of attacking me again the would-be assassin flees into the darkness. Clearly, someone does not wish for me to reach Mount Penglai.

A [Root.GetManWomanOpp] lunges at me from the shadows, and I barely make it out of the way in time. Instead of attacking me again the would-be assassin flees into the darkness. Clearly, someone does not wish for me to reach Mount Penglai.
Find that assassin!

A [Root.GetManWomanOpp] lunges at me from the shadows, and I am in no position to avoid the attack. I take multiple stab wounds, collapsing to the deck, and can feel my vision start to fade even before the assassin slips back into the shadows. Eternal life will not be mine.

A [Root.GetManWomanOpp] lunges at me from the shadows, and I am in no position to avoid the attack. I take multiple stab wounds, collapsing to the deck, and can feel my vision start to fade even before the assassin slips back into the shadows. This expedition is over, as is my life.
So it ends...

The expedition I sent to find Mount Penglai has returned rather more quickly than expected. I quickly discover that this is because [From.GetBestName] was killed by an unknown assailant and that nobody else felt that they had the authority to assume command.
Who could have been behind it?

The expedition [penglai_sender.GetBestName] sent to find Mount Penglai has returned rather more quickly than expected. If the rumours are to be believed the early return was due to [From.GetBestName] being killed by an unknown assailant.
Who could have been behind it?

The expedition [penglai_sender.GetBestName] sent to find Mount Penglai has returned rather more quickly than expected. If the rumours are to be believed the early return was due to [From.GetBestName] being killed by an unknown assailant. The [From.GetManWomanOpp] I hired, I would assume.
A job well done!

[From.GetBestName]'s attempt to reach Mount Penglai in order to claim a Peach of Immortality has failed. The ships returned to port today, carrying with them [From.GetBestName]'s dead body, laid low by an unknown assassin.
Who could have been behind it?

[From.GetBestName]'s attempt to reach Mount Penglai in order to claim a Peach of Immortality has failed. The ships returned to port today, carrying with them [From.GetBestName]'s dead body, laid low by an unknown assassin. The [From.GetManWomanOpp] I hired, I suspect.
A job well done!
The weather has been unexpectedly pleasant ever since the ships left port. The wind could perhaps be a bit stronger to help speed us on our way, but I certainly cannot complain.
The weather has been unexpectedly pleasant ever since the ships left port. The wind could perhaps be a bit stronger to help speed us on our way, but I certainly cannot complain.
Let's hope it keeps up...
Heavy rain and strong winds from unexpected directions has become quite familiar to me, seeing as neither has let up for long since the expedition left port.
Heavy rain and strong winds from unexpected directions has become quite familiar to me, seeing as neither has let up for long since the expedition left port.
I was hoping for a nicer voyage...

The voyage towards Mount Penglai is taking some time, and that has given me plenty of time to think. Not every expedition that has set out in the past has returned, and perhaps this will not end with me gaining eternal life.

The voyage towards Mount Penglai is taking some time, and that has given me plenty of time to think. Not every expedition that has set out in the past has returned, and perhaps this journey will be the death of me.
I cannot turn back! Not yet!
We should turn back...

We have not seen any signs of land for weeks, and both our rations and my patience is starting to run out. If Mount Penglai truly is real, then we will not reach it anytime soon. Eternal life will have to wait.

We have not seen any signs of land for weeks, and both our rations and my patience is starting to run out. If Mount Penglai truly is real, then we will not reach it anytime soon. [penglai_sender.GetBestName] will not be happy, but [penglai_sender.GetSheHe] ought to know most expeditions to Mount Penglai are unsuccessful.
We must head back...

A great storm is brewing ahead of us. Going around it is not going to be possible, and going through it would be dangerous. If we turn around now, we would probably be able to outrun it, however, though that would mean giving up on reaching Mount Penglai.

A great storm is brewing ahead of us. Going around it is not going to be possible, and going through it would be dangerous. If we turn around now, we would probably be able to outrun it, however, though that would mean giving up on reaching Mount Penglai.
We press on!
We must head back...

One by one, the masts of the ships are brought down by wind and lightning. Great waves batter the crippled ships to pieces over the next few hours, and though I believe one of the ships managed to escape it was not my ship. I am thrown into the ocean, and it is clear there will be no escaping my fate.

One by one, the masts of the ships are brought down by wind and lightning. Great waves batter the crippled ships to pieces over the next few hours, and though I believe one of the ships managed to escape it was not my ship. I am thrown into the ocean, and it is clear there will be no escaping my fate.
And so it ends...

Today a ship limped into port, seemingly held together more by the prayers of the sailors aboard than anything physical. If the sailors aboard are to be believed, they are the only ones left alive from the expedition to Mount Penglai following an ill-advised decision by [From.GetBestName] to sail directly into an oncoming storm.
What terrible news!

Today a ship limped into port, seemingly held together more by the prayers of the sailors aboard than anything physical. If the sailors aboard are to be believed, they are the only ones left alive from the expedition to Mount Penglai following an ill-advised decision by [From.GetBestName] to sail directly into an oncoming storm.
I see...

Today a ship limped into port, seemingly held together more by the prayers of the sailors aboard than anything physical. If the sailors aboard are to be believed, they are the only ones left alive from the expedition to Mount Penglai following an ill-advised decision by [From.GetBestName] to sail directly into an oncoming storm.
I see...
Though the experience is rather unpleasant and the ships take some damage, the sailors are skilled enough to keep them afloat, and we pass through the storm without too much difficulty.
Though the experience is rather unpleasant and the ships take some damage, the sailors are skilled enough to keep them afloat, and we pass through the storm without too much difficulty.
Onwards to glory!
Several of the other ships are battered apart by the storm, and my ship barely stays in one piece. We cannot continue to Mount Penglai.
Several of the other ships are battered apart by the storm, and my ship barely stays in one piece. We cannot continue to Mount Penglai.
We must turn back...

Today I was informed that a great many sharks have been seen swimming around the ships, and that the number seems to be increasing. Some of the sailors seem to think that this is a sign we should turn back around.

Today I was informed that a great many sharks have been seen swimming around the ships, and that the number seems to be increasing. Some of the sailors seem to think that this is a sign we should turn back around.
We press on!
We must head back...

I give the order to continue and stand by the captain's side as the [Root.GetManWoman] steers us deeper into the shark-infested waters to make sure the order is carried out. Satisfied, I walk over towards the bow of the ship, but on my way there my feet slip and I tumble overboard.

I give the order to continue and stand by the captain's side as the [Root.GetManWoman] steers us deeper into the shark-infested waters to make sure the order is carried out. Satisfied, I walk over towards the bow of the ship, but on my way there my feet slip and I tumble overboard.
No! Not like this!

The expedition I sent to find Mount Penglai has returned rather more quickly than expected. Apparently [From.GetBestName] slipped and fell overboard in shark-infested waters, and with [From.GetHerHim] dead there was nobody left with the authority to continue the expedition.
What terrible news!

The expedition [penglai_sender.GetBestName] sent to find Mount Penglai has returned rather more quickly than expected. Apparently [From.GetBestName] slipped and fell overboard in shark-infested waters, and with [From.GetHerHim] dead there was nobody left with the authority to continue the expedition.
I see...

Today the ships that departed as part of [From.GetBestName]'s expedition to reahc Mount Penglai returned without [From.GetBestName]. Rumour has it [From.GetSheHe] slipped and fell overboard in shark-infested waters, resulting in [From.GetHerHis] painful demise.
I see...

I give the order to continue and stand by the captain's side as the [Root.GetManWoman] steers us deeper into the shark-infested waters to make sure the order is carried out. Satisfied, I walk over towards the bow of the ship, drawing my sword and pointing it at the horizon, hopefully inspiring everyone to press on.

I give the order to continue and stand by the captain's side as the [Root.GetManWoman] steers us deeper into the shark-infested waters to make sure the order is carried out. Satisfied, I walk over towards the bow of the ship, drawing my sword and pointing it at the horizon, hopefully inspiring everyone to press on.
Onwards to glory!

Perhaps there was something to the sailors' superstition. A great number of accidents befall them over the next few days, resulting in many falling overboard. The sharks devour them eagerly, and it has become clear to me that we can continue no further.

Perhaps there was something to the sailors' superstition. A great number of accidents befall them over the next few days, resulting in many falling overboard. The sharks devour them eagerly, and it has become clear to me that we can continue no further.
We must turn back...
The Lone Mountain

Land at last! I was starting to give up hope that we would encounter any islands before our supplies ran out and my attempt to obtain a Peach of Immortality ended in failure, but at last we have sighted one dead ahead!\nThe island ahead appears to be almost entirely covered by a lush jungle, though towards its centre a single majestic mountain rises above the treeline. It looks rather inviting, and if I was not meant to rule back home I could well see myself retiring to it to live out an eternal life of peace and tranquility.\nThere are no signs of other humans to be found as we draw close to the shoreline, but that does not mean this is not Mount Penglai. After all, all the legends say the Immortals live on the mountain.

Land at last! I was starting to give up hope that we would encounter any islands before our supplies ran out and I had to return to [penglai_sender.GetBestName] in failure, but at last we have sighted one dead ahead!\nThe island ahead appears to be almost entirely covered by a lush jungle, though towards its centre a single majestic mountain rises above the treeline. It looks rather inviting, and if not for my obligations back hume I could well see myself staying for quite some time.\nThere are no signs of other humans to be found as we draw close to the shoreline, but that does not mean this is not Mount Penglai. After all, all the legends say the Immortals live on the mountain.
That mountain must be Mount Penglai!

The trek through the jungle is not particularly easy going as the undergrowth is quite thick, but eventually I and the rest of the landing party make it to the base of the mountain. Regardless of whether it is Mount Penglai or not, it is time to start climbing.

The trek through the jungle is not particularly easy going as the undergrowth is quite thick, but eventually I and the rest of the landing party make it to the base of the mountain. Regardless of whether it is Mount Penglai or not, it is time to start climbing.
We much reach the summit!

The ascent is not too difficult, but we see no signs of humans as we move towards the summit. Once there, all we find is a number of hot springs, and though we investigate the area thoroughly it seems no human has ever set foot in the area before.

The ascent is not too difficult, but we see no signs of humans as we move towards the summit. Once there, all we find is a number of hot springs, and though we investigate the area thoroughly it seems no human has ever set foot in the area before.
We should head back...

The return trip to the ships is fairly uneventful, and we are soon back on the ships. The trek through the jungle and up the mountain has been invigorating, and perhaps good for my health, even if I have not gained eternal life.
The return trip to the ships is fairly uneventful, and we are soon back on the ships. The trek through the jungle and up the mountain has been invigorating, and perhaps good for my health.
Time to head back home...

The ascent is not too difficult until the very end. Without warning, the mountain starts to quake beneath us, and several of my companions fall to their deaths. Even worse, a great plume of smoke and fire erupts from the summit. This is a volcano, not Mount Penglai.

The ascent is not too difficult until the very end. Without warning, the mountain starts to quake beneath us, and several of my companions fall to their deaths. Even worse, a great plume of smoke and fire erupts from the summit. This is a volcano, not Mount Penglai.
Back to the ships! Now!

I make it back down to the base of the volcano together with a good number of my companions, but the fire raining down from the sky has reached the jungle before us, setting it ablaze. We try to make our way around the fire, but soon we find ourselves surrounded by flames.

I make it back down to the base of the volcano together with a good number of my companions, but the fire raining down from the sky has reached the jungle before us, setting it ablaze. We try to make our way around the fire, but soon we find ourselves surrounded by flames.
No! Not like this!

The survivors of the expedition I sent to search for Mount Penglai have returned. [From.GetBestName] is not among them, and rumour has it [From.GetSheHe] perished trying to escape an inferno resulting from the eruption of a volcano [From.GetSheHe] apparently believed was Mount Penglai.
I see...

The survivors of the expedition [penglai_sender.GetBestName] sent to search for Mount Penglai have returned. [From.GetBestName] is not among them, and rumour has it [From.GetSheHe] perished trying to escape an inferno resulting from the eruption of a volcano [From.GetSheHe] apparently believed was Mount Penglai.
I see...

The survivors of the expedition [From.GetBestName] sent to search for Mount Penglai have returned. [From.GetBestName] is not among them, supposedly because [From.GetSheHe] perished trying to return to the ships from an erupting volcano that [From.GetSheHe] unwisely was climbing.
I see...
Narrowly outrunning the fire raining down from the sky and the blazing inferno raging in the jungle as a result, I and the other survivors make it back to the ships. We cannot stay here any longer.
Narrowly outrunning the fire raining down from the sky and the blazing inferno raging in the jungle as a result, I and the other survivors make it back to the ships. We cannot stay here any longer.
Cast off! Now!
